title: 第403章 你家吵起来了
slug: 离婚当天前夫小叔连夜抢我领证
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

只是，还没走出会议室大门，林见微就被一个技术员叫住。

“林总工，第三实验室的高温合金材料实验出了点问题，数据对不上，您能不能去看看？”

林见微皱了皱眉，脚下已经转了方向。

她对这些事从来不会推。

不管多晚，不管多累，只要实验出了问题，她一定第一时间赶到现场。

专家组几人对视了一眼，不约而同地跟了上去。

他们想亲眼看看，这个年轻的林总工到底有多强，是不是真的经得起实战检验。

结果自然不负众望。

前后不到二十分钟，问题就被林见微解决了。

三人心底最后一丝疑虑也彻底消散，对林见微心服口服，五体投地。

接下来的几天，林见微白天跟专家组讨论航母方案，晚上加班处理所里的各种技术问题，有时间就回林家看看。

好在那对母女除了爱慕虚荣、贪图享受、嘴碎唠叨之外，倒也没有再闹出什么大的幺蛾子。

方安雅虽然心里膈应得不行，但为了稳住这母女俩，每天好吃好喝地供着。

今天红烧肉明天糖醋排骨后天炖鸡汤，顿顿不重样，把田母吃得嘴都油了。

田小娥更是在林家找到了当“少奶奶”的感觉。

最让田小娥上瘾的，是林家的卫生间。

自从来了林家，她每天都洗澡，有时候一天洗两次。

其实也没出什么汗，就是惦记着那瓶香喷喷的沐浴露和那个会出热水的花洒。

在乡下的时候，洗澡要去镇上的公共澡堂，一个月能洗一次就不错了，水还常常不热，洗完了身上还是干的。

现在好了，想洗就洗，水又大又热，沐浴露抹在身上滑溜溜的，冲完了整个浴室都是香的。

可这天洗完澡，她擦干身体的时候，发现了一些不对劲的地方。

她的手臂上、后背上、大腿上，长出了一片一片的疹子。

Page (1/3)

However, before Lin Jianwei could walk out of the conference room door, he was stopped by a technician.

"General Engineer Lin, there is something wrong with the high-temperature alloy material experiment in the Third Laboratory. The data does not match up. Can you go and take a look?"

Lin Jian frowned slightly and turned his feet.

She never pushed back on these things.

No matter how late it is, no matter how tired she is, if something goes wrong in the experiment, she will rush to the scene as soon as possible.

Several members of the expert team looked at each other and followed him in unison.

They wanted to see with their own eyes how strong this young Engineer Lin was and whether he could really stand the test of actual combat.

The results certainly lived up to expectations.

In less than twenty minutes, the problem was solved by Lin Jianwei.

The last trace of doubt in the hearts of the three people was completely dissipated, and they were convinced of Lin Jianwei and fell into submission.

In the next few days, Lin Jianwei discussed the aircraft carrier plan with the expert team during the day, worked overtime at night to deal with various technical problems in the institute, and went back to Lin's house to visit when he had time.

Fortunately, apart from being vain, greedy for enjoyment, and nagging, the mother and daughter didn't cause any big trouble.

Although Fang Anya felt very unhappy, but in order to stabilize the mother and daughter, she provided them with good food and drink every day.

Braised pork today, sweet and sour pork ribs stewed in chicken soup the day after tomorrow, every meal is different, making Tian Mu’s mouth feel oily after eating it.

Tian Xiao'e even found the feeling of being a "young mistress" in the Lin family.

What makes Tian Xiaoe most addicted is the Lin family bathroom.

Since coming to the Lin family, she has taken a shower every day, sometimes twice a day.

In fact, I didn't sweat much, I was just thinking about the bottle of fragrant shower gel and the shower head that produces hot water.

When I was in the countryside, I had to go to the public bathhouse in the town. It was good to take a bath once a month. The water was often not hot, and I was still dry after washing.

Now I'm fine, I can wash whenever I want, the water is big and hot, the shower gel is slippery on my body, and the whole bathroom is fragrant after washing.

But after taking a shower that day, when she dried her body, she discovered something was wrong.

There were patches of rash on her arms, back, and thighs.
